title: 第521章 爱情的酸臭味第520章 政法的力量
content_zh:
雨过天晴，一切犹如无事发生一样。
燕赤霞和知秋一叶坐在桌前，手里还捧着已经凉透的茶杯，目光却齐刷刷地移向了许仙。
他们在等待，等待着这个主人公的决定，等待着这场跨越千年的因果，最终走向何方。
然而，许仙还是那个许仙，依旧那么地优柔寡断。
即使林道然把过去、现在、未来都说给他听了，他还是下不了决心。
他的脸色，如同调色盘一般，变幻不定，一会苍白，一会潮红，一会又变得纠结......
嘴唇不停颤抖着，张开又合上，合上又张开，仿佛有千言万语堵在喉咙里，却怎么也吐不出来。
“我......”
他的声音，微弱如蚊蚋，带着一种令人心烦的犹豫。
“让我再想想......”
这一想，就想了三天。
这三天里，因为知道小青也是蛇妖，并且还在保安堂看家，导致许仙连保安堂都不敢回。
他身着那件已经穿了三天、沾满尘土和汗渍的长衫，头发凌乱，胡须拉碴，像个落魄的乞丐一样。
这三天，吃喝拉撒都蹭上清观的。
知秋一叶的房间被他占了，只能去跟燕赤霞住在一起。
“观主......”
知秋一叶满脸幽怨地看着林道然。
“这许大夫还要想多久啊？我房间都被他占三天了！我不想再和燕老头睡一个房间，燕老头跟个酒鬼一样，每晚都要找我拼酒，再喝下去，我早晚被他喝死！”
林道然躺在躺椅上，双手垂在两侧，双腿交叠，一晃一晃地辛苦“修炼”着。
他眯着眼，看着天边的最后一抹阳光消失，晚霞如血，染红了半边天空。

“快了！”
他的声音，慵懒而随意，带着一种令人心安的从容。
“该想通的，应该想通了。想不通的，再想下去也没用！”
他伸了个懒腰，从躺椅上站起身来，骨骼发出“噼里啪啦”的声响。
“许大夫......”
林道然突然开口，声音平淡却清晰地传入每个人的耳中。
“你应该，差不多做好决定了吧？”
许仙正蹲在一旁，用一根树枝在地上画着圈圈，听到林道然的话，他的身体猛地一僵。
然后，他缓缓站起身来，用力地点了点头，脸上的纠结之色，如同退潮的海水，慢慢消失。
取而代之的，是一种决绝，一种......破釜沉舟的勇气。
“嗯！林观主，我做好决定了！！！”
许仙深吸一口气，眼眶微微泛红，声音变得沙哑而哽咽。
“娘子这般用心对我，我也不能让她失望！区区蛇妖身份罢了......”
许仙的目光，变得炽热而明亮，如两轮小太阳在眼眸中燃烧，他伸出右手，在空中握紧成拳。
“只要我俩真心相爱，人妖有别也阻碍不了我们！！！”
林道然挑了挑眉，嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹意味深长的笑容。
然后，他对着院子外，大声喊道：
“白素贞，听到没？”
content_en:
After the rain, the sky cleared up, and everything seemed like nothing happened.
Yan Chixia and Zhiqiu Yiye were sitting at the table, still holding cold teacups in their hands, but their eyes moved towards Xu Xian.
They are waiting, waiting for the protagonist's decision, waiting for where this cause and effect spanning thousands of years will eventually go.
However, Xu Xian was still the same Xu Xian, still so indecisive.
Even though Lin Daoran told him the past, present and future, he still couldn't make up his mind.
His face, like a palette, changes erratically, sometimes pale, sometimes flushed, and sometimes tangled...
His lips kept trembling, opening and closing, closing and opening again, as if there were thousands of words stuck in his throat, but he couldn't spit them out.
"I..."
His voice was as weak as a gnat, with an annoying hesitation.
"Let me think again..."
I thought about this for three days.
In the past three days, Xu Xian did not even dare to return to the security hall because he knew that Xiaoqing was also a snake demon and was still looking after the house in the security hall.
He was wearing a long robe that had been worn for three days and was stained with dust and sweat. His hair was messy and his beard was unkempt, like a down-and-out beggar.
In the past three days, I have been eating, drinking, and drinking.
Zhiqiu Yiye's room was occupied by him, so he had no choice but to live with Yan Chixia.
"Guanzhu..."
Zhiqiu Yiye looked at Lin Daoran with resentment on his face.
"How long will Dr. Xu think about this? He has occupied my room for three days! I don't want to sleep in the same room with Old Man Yan anymore. Old Man Yan is like an alcoholic. He wants to fight with me every night. If he keeps drinking, I will be drunk to death by him sooner or later!"
Lin Daoran was lying on the recliner, his hands hanging on his sides, his legs crossed, and he was "practicing" hard in a flash.
He squinted his eyes and watched the last ray of sunshine disappear from the horizon, and the sunset glow was like blood, dyeing half of the sky red.
"Soon!"
His voice was lazy and casual, with a reassuring calmness.
"What should be figured out should be figured out. What can't be figured out, there's no point in thinking about it anymore!"
He stretched and stood up from the recliner, his bones making a crackling sound.
"Doctor Xu..."
Lin Daoran suddenly spoke, and his voice was calm but clear in everyone's ears.
"You should have almost made your decision, right?"
Xu Xian was squatting aside and drawing circles on the ground with a branch. When he heard Lin Daoran's words, his body stiffened suddenly.
Then, he slowly stood up and nodded vigorously. The tangled look on his face slowly disappeared like the ebbing sea water.
Instead, there is a kind of determination, a kind of... courage to break the boat.
"Well! Guanzhu Lin, I have made a decision!!!"
Xu Xian took a deep breath, his eyes turned slightly red, and his voice became hoarse and choked.
"My wife treats me with such care, I can't let her down! She's just a snake demon..."
Xu Xian's eyes became hot and bright, like two little suns burning in his eyes. He stretched out his right hand and clenched it into a fist in the air.
"As long as we truly love each other, the difference between men and women won't stop us!!!"
Lin Daoran raised his eyebrows, raised the corners of his mouth slightly, and revealed a meaningful smile.
Then, he shouted loudly to the outside of the yard:
"Bai Suzhen, did you hear that?"
